releaseStatus.note: 2.5.3 is the current public release and is available through the public updater feed. It adds GLOBAL VM controls, canvas capture, and a 49-tool bundled native MCP surface. Configured official builds show a first-run anonymous-reporting notice and keep the opt-out in Settings; see Privacy.

entities.name: RAV
entities.description: RAV desktop Rive animation viewer. The 2.5.3 release adds a collapsed GLOBAL VM collection above ROOT VM with independent global trees, six global-ViewModel MCP tools, rav_capture_canvas, and a 49-tool bundled native MCP surface.
